:::{#def-momentum}
#### Momentum (heavy-ball method)

Let $f : \reals^p \to \reals$ have first [partial derivatives](vector-calculus.qmd#def-partial-derivative),
let $\vx^{(0)}$ be a starting point,
let $\steplen > 0$ be a [step length](#def-gradient-descent),
and let $\beta \in [0, 1)$ be a [momentum coefficient](#def-momentum-coefficient).
**Momentum** (the **heavy-ball method**) is the sequence given, for $t = 1, 2, \ldots$, by

$$
\begin{aligned}
\vv^{(t)} &\eqdef \beta\,\vv^{(t-1)} + \deriv{\vx} f(\vx^{(t-1)}) \\
\vx^{(t)} &\eqdef \vx^{(t-1)} - \steplen\,\vv^{(t)},
\end{aligned}
$$

with $\vv^{(0)} \eqdef \vzero$.

:::
